facts.value: About NOK 7,500/month for housing in UiO's student budget (based on Eurostudent 8 survey data)
facts.notes: This is the housing line of a student budget, not a measured market average for a room. SiO room prices were not visible on SiO's static pages.

facts.value: NOK 10,090/month average rent for a 1-room dwelling in Oslo and Bærum (2025)
facts.notes: 2-room dwellings: NOK 15,260/month (2025). Next SSB update scheduled 21 Dec 2026.

facts.value: About NOK 15,250/month incl. housing (UiO budget); UDI requires NOK 15,488/month for permits (2026-2027)
facts.notes: UiO breakdown: housing 7,500; food 3,500; transport 700; study costs 1,000; leisure 700; phone/internet 400; health 250; other 1,200. The UiO page does not state the year of the figures (last modified April 2026).

facts.value: Ruter student 30-day ticket, zone 1: NOK 393 (prices from 1 Aug 2026); 40% off adult, students under 30

Vy reports the student ticket is NOK 100 cheaper from 1 Nov 2026 (adult zone 1 NOK 495), which would make it about NOK 293; not confirmed on a Ruter page.

facts.value: Cold winters, mild summers: average about -2.3 °C in January and 17.7 °C in July (Blindern); about 837 mm precipitation/year

Norwegian for almost all UiO bachelor's (only one taught in English); master's options in English; few part-time jobs without Norwegian

facts.value: UiO warns it can be difficult to get a part-time job to supplement your budget; few jobs open to students without Norwegian
No general minimum wage; legal floors e.g. hospitality NOK 215.29/h, cleaning NOK 247.29/h (from 6 Nov 2026)
facts.notes: These are sector minimums (national), not measured typical student pay in Oslo. Hospitality rate is for over-20s (or 18+ with 4 months' experience). No citable source for typical student hourly pay was found.
